operationalRelevance.requiredEvidence: An active or native-attention worker/session must have exact current-work tool evidence before capability resolution and projection.
evidenceSources: RuntimeRecord.toolNames for runtimes linked by task runtimeIds, taskId, or primaryRuntimeId
operationalRelevance.noEvidenceBehavior: Capability resolver is skipped and no derived Human Control item is projected; Worker Profile remains the comprehensive capability surface.
operationalRelevance.productionPath: getHumanControlInbox -> resolveHumanControlCapabilityCandidates -> relevance prefilter -> getWorkerEffectiveCapabilities -> projectCapabilityAttention

semanticDeduplication.approvalVsBlocked: A blocked capability is suppressed only when the approval shares work context and exact tool identity.
semanticDeduplication.approvalVsRuntime: Shared native work context takes approval precedence; unrelated runtime work remains visible.
semanticDeduplication.questionVsRuntime: A question takes precedence only for the same proven task/session work.
semanticDeduplication.repeatedNativeEvents: No duplicate projection identity is created.

attentionRefresh.transport: Existing /api/stream EventSource and existing OpenClaw event bridge
attentionRefresh.signal: Existing stream emits an attention event containing the event-bridge attentionRevision only for attention-relevant native events.
attentionRefresh.genericSnapshotUnchangedAttention: No attention event and no full Inbox reload.
attentionRefresh.openInbox: One approximately 150ms coalesced reload while open.
attentionRefresh.pendingMutation: Background refresh is deferred until the action's explicit native reread settles.
attentionRefresh.questionDrafts: Preserved by native questionId while still pending; removed when the question disappears from the authoritative list.

performance.candidatePrefilter: Only deduplicated active/native contexts with exact tool evidence reach capability resolution.

runtimeCertification.sameConnectionExecLifecycleNote: The exact disposable runtime did not fan approval lifecycle events back to the same native subscriber; action paths explicitly reread authoritative state and architecture does not depend on same-connection event fanout.
runtimeCertification.pluginApprovalSkipReason: Safe fixture creation requires a trusted plugin runtime owner.

remainingRisks: The exact runtime still does not guarantee same-connection exec approval lifecycle event fanout; explicit native rereads and reconnect reconciliation remain the correctness path.
Plugin approval live fixture creation remains unavailable without a trusted plugin runtime owner.
Provider-specific capability evidence remains dependent on the existing native channel/account adapter coverage.
